monday.focus: Metabolic reset, steady sweat, and a clean keto start.
monday.title: Metabolic Circuit + Walk
main: 4 rounds: 10 squats, 8 pushups, 12 reverse lunges, 20 mountain climbers
monday.surfBenefit: Builds the base engine for longer sessions without cooking your legs early in the week.

tuesday.weeklyPlan: Surf if possible, otherwise Zone 2 cardio + mobility
tuesday.focus: Get water time if conditions line up; otherwise build aerobic glide.
tuesday.title: Surf Option or Zone 2 + Mobility
warmup: World's greatest stretch x 4 each side
main: If not surfing: 35-45 minutes Zone 2 walk, bike, or easy jog
tuesday.surfBenefit: Zone 2 work improves paddle stamina and recovery between waves.

wednesday.focus: Pop-up power, core stiffness, and practical strength.
wednesday.title: Pop-Up Power Strength
main: 5 rounds: 5 controlled pop-ups, 10 pushups, 12 squats, 30-second plank
Optional: 3 sets of 10 dumbbell rows each side
Stop one rep before form breaks
cooldown: Hip flexor stretch, 60 seconds each side
wednesday.surfBenefit: Sharpens the transition from paddle to feet while keeping shoulders and trunk honest.

thursday.weeklyPlan: Light mobility + easy walk only. Protect Friday surf energy.
thursday.focus: Downshift, hydrate, and leave your legs fresh for Friday.
thursday.title: Friday Prep Mobility
main: Thoracic open books x 8 each side
thursday.surfBenefit: Protects Friday dawn patrol by banking recovery instead of chasing fatigue.

friday.weeklyPlan: Morning surf session. Optional evening stretch only.
friday.focus: Morning surf is the workout. Fuel clean and keep the day simple.
friday.title: Friday Dawn Patrol
main: Focus on calm paddling, clean positioning, and smooth pop-ups
friday.surfBenefit: This is the priority session. Show up fresh, surf present, and leave with energy.

saturday.weeklyPlan: Second surf if possible, otherwise long walk/hike/run.
saturday.focus: Second water touch or long aerobic work.
saturday.title: Second Surf or Long Easy Engine
main: If not surfing: long walk, hike, or easy run
saturday.surfBenefit: Adds the second weekly surf touch or the aerobic base that makes paddling feel easier.

sunday.weeklyPlan: Mobility + meal prep + optional light workout.
sunday.focus: Reset the kitchen, loosen the body, and make Monday easy.
sunday.title: Mobility + Meal Prep Reset
main: Optional: 2 easy rounds of squats, pushups, and planks
Prep protein and low-carb food for the next two days
sunday.surfBenefit: Keeps the body loose and removes food friction before the week starts.
